as_of_content:
[[File:I Still Function newsfeed.jpg|thumb|220x220px]]
'''I Still Function''' is a Spotlight Mission featuring [[Megatron]] that ran from November 30th, 2017 to January 5th, 2018, 5 am PDT.

This mission was "reforged" (updated) to the latest difficulty, rewards, and minibosses, and re-ran from January 12, 2019 to February 7, 2019.

== Transcript ==
[[I Still Function/Transcript]]

== Rewards ==

== Chapter 1: Enter the Decepticon ==

=== The Art of Fighting ===
* Boss: '''Bludgeon'''

=== Another Arrival ===
* Boss: '''Motormaster '''

== Chapter 2: Mega Functions ==

=== A Question of Functionality ===
* Boss''': G1 Starscream'''

=== Be Prepared, Be Very Prepared ===
* Boss: G1 Soundwave

== Chapter 3: Megatronic Mayhem ==
===Serve Your Masters===
* Boss: '''G1 Shockwave'''

===The One and Only===
* Boss: '''G1 Megatron'''
